text_block_list.text: The day of the Osaka Hai has arrived.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув entered this race expecting
to face
off against her rival, but it turns
out Silence
Suzuka is not running.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Nonetheless, Эйр Грув heads to the
track
determined to give a race worthy
of the Empress
name.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
